get.summary: Save a whole saga into one file .cksaga.
get.description: The file canonkeeper-saga v1 (specs/2026-11-13-desk-sagafile.md SF1): the text of the books with their faces, the chapter cards that fit the text, the registry of names, the finished layer of threads, the records of the saga, the notes of the owner made in it and the turns of the owner in its chats. The rights and the saga are checked and the base is read in one snapshot before the first byte; the chats follow as their threads are read and the manifest goes last, so a file that cannot be finished ends with a broken connection and has no manifest. No model takes part. One save of an author at a time, four for the process, ten an hour.

post.summary: Open a saga file as a new saga.
post.description: Only the desktop app mounts it (specs/2026-11-13-desk-sagafile.md SF3). The file is checked whole before anything is written: a refusal names one cause — saga_archive.not_archive, saga_archive.damaged, saga_archive.newer_version, saga_archive.too_large, saga_archive.no_space or saga_archive.invalid with the name of the record. The saga is new: new ids of the saga, its books, chapters and paragraphs, the text, the keys of the chapters and the numbers of the books as in the file; a card is taken when the digest of its chapter in the file is its own, and the report names the chapters left without one. Nothing existing changes and no model is called. A repeat with the same key and file answers the same saga; the same key with another file is 409.

post.summary: Declare a choice of the folder of the Obsidian vault of a saga to the shell.
post.description: Mounted only by the desktop build (specs/2026-11-13-desk-obsidian.md). OB1.1: the backend declares a choice — the saga, a number of 32 random bytes, 10 minutes, one in the process, a new one puts out the one before — and tells the shell the number with the title of the saga (folder-choice of the control channel). The window then calls the command pick_folder of the shell with the number: the shell opens the system window over the app and answers the window only with the outcome — linked, a refusal with its reason, canceled or expired — after the backend checked and kept the folder. The path never reaches the page. Without the shell obsidian.choice_unavailable (503). The strict Origin of the window, the CSRF token and its session.

get.summary: Look over the Obsidian vault of a saga: its folders with notes.
get.description: Mounted only by the desktop build (specs/2026-11-13-desk-obsidian.md). OB2: the tree of the folders of the vault by the entries of its directories, without a note read and without a link followed — the folders with notes, the notes in each folder and below it, what was skipped by its reasons (link, hidden, cloud_only, not_note, too_big, service, unreadable), and a hint to the folders of the first two levels: book (with _book.md or linked to a book), materials with the kind of their records, skip. Past 200 000 entries or 32 levels the tree is cut with truncated and its numbers, not refused. Nothing is written, no text of a note is given, every path is relative to the vault. One operation of a saga reads a vault at a time and two in the process (obsidian.busy, 429 with Retry-After); a vault that does not answer in 20 s is obsidian.slow (503); a saga without a vault obsidian.not_linked, a vault that does not open obsidian.vault_missing with its reason (409).

post.summary: Say what a load of the chosen folders of the Obsidian vault of a saga would give, writing nothing.
post.description: Mounted only by the desktop build (specs/2026-11-13-desk-obsidian.md). OB4: the choice — folders as books, folders as materials with the kind of their records, folders and notes left out, all relative to the vault — is checked before a note is read: no book holds another or a folder linked to a book (obsidian.folders_overlap with both, 422); a path of no folder of the vault, through a link or on a dot is request.validation. More than 20 000 notes or 200 MB, or chosen folders of more than 200 000 files and folders, is obsidian.too_large with the numbers (422). Each folder of a book becomes one text of Markdown read by the code of the import queue: the chapters and their signs, whether the queue takes it (refusal: its code), the warnings — chapters_differ with the notes that split or joined, book_in_note, order_by_name, title_cut —, what did not go into the text, its state (new; linked to a book — changed when «Обновить из файла» of the book by the text would change it, by the plan of the update against the book now; or queued, its volume in work of a queue — specs/2026-11-14-desk-obsidian-books.md OK0.3, OK0.4) and the fingerprint of the text. Each note of materials becomes a future record with its state — new, in_book, in_book_by_alias, same_note, edited_in_app, other_source — and warnings list_note, several_sections; the set has its fingerprint. reading says the chapters and signs of new and changed books and whether the saga waits for a helper or a consent. No model is called, nothing is written into the saga or the vault. One operation of a saga reads a vault at a time (obsidian.busy, 429); 2 minutes, 5 s a note (obsidian.slow, 503). The strict Origin of the window, the CSRF token and its session.

post.summary: Put the books of folders of the Obsidian vault of a saga onto its shelf by the queue of the volumes.
post.description: Mounted only by the desktop build (specs/2026-11-14-desk-obsidian-books.md OK1). The choice the author saw in the preview (previewObsidianImport) and the fingerprint of each folder of a book. The answer kept for the Idempotency-Key comes first, before the vault is read: after a success it is the same when a folder changed; another request under the key is idempotency.conflict; a key whose load made its queue and kept no answer — the process fell — is obsidian.load_interrupted (409): a new load needs a new key. Each folder is glued again by the code of the preview: another glue is obsidian.folder_changed with the folders (409) and nothing is written. Each volume is checked by the code of the queue. The outcome of each folder: queued in the queue, linked — a live book holds it —, in_trash — its book lies in «Недавно удалённые» —, refused with the code of the queue (a limit of the books of the saga refuses every volume). With no volume to queue there is no queue. The queue of the core is the first write: a saga with a live queue of the volumes is obsidian.queue_busy with that queue (409) and nothing is written; then the links of its volumes, their files and its start, one upload a volume as at the shelf. A failure after the queue was made cancels its draft and is kept for the key. No model is called. One operation of a saga reads a vault at a time (obsidian.busy, 429); only its reading is within 2 minutes (obsidian.slow, 503: nothing is written); its writes go to their end when the caller goes away. The strict Origin of the window, the CSRF token and its session.

post.summary: Write the records of «Ваши материалы» of the notes of folders of the Obsidian vault of a saga.
post.description: Mounted only by the desktop build (specs/2026-11-15-desk-obsidian-notes.md ON1). The choice the author saw in the preview (previewObsidianImport), the fingerprint of the records of each folder of materials (materials.folders of the preview), what the author saw of the record of each note (materials.records[].seen of the preview) and his decisions: replace or keep by a note, or one rule a state (replace: edited_in_app, other_source). The answer kept for the Idempotency-Key comes first, before the vault is read: after a success it is the same when a note changed; another request under the key is idempotency.conflict. The notes of the folders of materials are read again by the code of the preview: another fingerprint of a folder is obsidian.folder_changed with the folders (409) and nothing is written. Then one transaction: the states again by the exact keys of the names with the records locked — a record whose state is not the one its preview saw (the author made or changed a record since) is kept and named —; new, in_book and in_book_by_alias are new records of the source obsidian with the path of the note; same_note is written only when the note changed; edited_in_app and other_source only by a decision to replace — other_source gives the same record the note and its link, and the note the record had before loses its link —; a name another note of the load gets is never replaced; then the links of the notes and the answer of the key. A failure of any part writes nothing; a name another record took meanwhile is conflict (409), nothing written. More than 5 000 records of the load or of the saga after it is obsidian.too_large with records, sagaRecords and limitRecords (422). No model, no row of an import, no Job, no upload of the day; the records of notes gone are not deleted. One operation of a saga reads a vault at a time (obsidian.busy, 429); only its reading is within 2 minutes (obsidian.slow, 503: nothing is written); its writes go to their end when the caller goes away. The strict Origin of the window, the CSRF token and its session.

post.summary: Export the map of a saga and the notes of its chapters into the folder of its export in its Obsidian vault.
post.description: Mounted only by the desktop build (specs/2026-11-15-desk-obsidian-export.md OE1). First one short transaction: the saga alive, the proof of the session, the role of an editor, the link of the vault. The answer kept for the Idempotency-Key is only of an export that ended (complete): its replay writes nothing; a replay after a failure or a partial answer exports again and comes to the same files. The map is read as the page of the map reads it: a saga without cards is obsidian.map_not_ready with reason no_cards, a map behind its cards obsidian.map_not_ready with reason updating — the Job of the cards is queued by the read of the map — (409); nothing is written then. Within 2 minutes only the reading of the folder of the export: its manifest (.canonkeeper/manifest.json) and the references the run replaces or moves; then the writes, each within a time of its own — past it the answer is partial at once and the next operation of the saga waits until the write returned. Everything is written only under the folder of the export, name after name without a link followed: a link or a file on the way to it is obsidian.export_dir_unsafe, a manifest of the folder of the saga that does not read obsidian.export_manifest_unreadable (409), nothing written. The folder is CanonKeeper/<the title of the saga>, « (2)» past a folder without the manifest of this saga, kept on the link before the first file. One file a node of the map (the nodes and the links the author took off the map left out), one a chapter with a card, Сага.md; a file the author changed (another fingerprint than the manifest keeps) is not updated without replaceChanged and, with it, moved into _Удалено/ — never written over; a reference of a node or a chapter that went is moved into _Удалено/; a file that does not read is skipped by its reason. No model, no Job, no record of what went out. One operation of a saga reads a vault at a time (obsidian.busy, 429), a reading past its time is obsidian.slow (503, nothing written). The strict Origin of the window, the CSRF token and its session; ten a minute for the window.

post.summary: Preview or apply «Обновить из файла» of a linked book with the text of its Obsidian folder now.
post.description: Mounted only by the desktop build (specs/2026-11-14-desk-obsidian-books.md OK2). The folder of the book is glued now by the choice of its load — the folders of materials and of other books inside it and the notes the author left out are no chapters — and goes to «Обновить из файла» of the core (importBookFile in update_preview or update_book): the answer is its start of the Job, and the plan is in the result of the Job (getJob). A preview gives the fingerprint of the glue and the report of the reading of the folder beside it — the notes skipped by their reasons, the warnings, the chapters as the import reads them, its state changed when the plan changes the book —; it is refused nothing for a plan that changes nothing. An application names the fingerprint of its preview: another glue is obsidian.folder_changed (409); notes that did not read for a passing reason (cloud_only, unreadable) are obsidian.notes_unread with their counts (409) until confirmUnread; a plan that changes nothing is obsidian.nothing_to_apply (409) — the update of the core would take the place of «Вернуть» of the update before. The Job of the Idempotency-Key of an application answers before the folder is glued. A book no folder is held by is obsidian.book_not_linked, the folder gone obsidian.folder_missing with it (409), a saga with a live queue of the volumes obsidian.queue_busy (409) before the vault is read. The refusals of the import are those of importBookFile. No model is called. One operation of a saga reads a vault at a time (obsidian.busy, 429); only its reading is within 2 minutes (obsidian.slow, 503: no Job). The strict Origin of the window, the CSRF token and its session.

The preview reads the snapshot of the update and the book as it stands now and names the chapters whose text comes back (text), those that get back their title, place and italic and bold (place), the chapters the update removed that come back from recently deleted (returned), the chapters the file added that go there for 7 days (removed) and the chapters that stay as they are now with why (kept: edited — changed after the update, deleted — deleted after it, returned — returned by hand already). Each chapter is named by its title now and, when the return gives it another one, by previousTitle. fingerprint names the book the preview read: revertBookUpdate carries it. It changes nothing. A book being updated from a file answers 409 book.busy, a book without a live update 404 book.update_gone. Cache-Control: no-store.

A return is not an upload: no import Job, no upload of the day, no limit of books; the chapters and text it brings back are held against the limits of chapters and characters of the tier (409 with the quota code, nothing changes). The text index, the cards, the names, the threads and the map are built again by their ordinary path; notes keep their places as after any change of text, chats are untouched. A book being updated answers 409 book.busy, a book without a live update 404 book.update_gone, the demo saga 409 demo_saga.read_only. The answer is the book as listBooks gives it. A skipped volume left the upload.

position.description: The row of the volume: the order of the rows is the order of the volumes after the books of the shelf (UP2.3).

ChapterDraftNote.description: A note on a chapter in writing at its exact place of the working text (specs/2026-11-02-writer-workshop.md, W6, W7.1; specs/2026-11-06-writing-agent.md). Of the helper: canon, a discrepancy with the canon at a quote; question, a question card with 2–4 options; replaced, what it replaced on the author's direct request. Of the Job of the writing agent: variant, a variant of a place, replacement its text, quote the place; new, style, canon, craft, seam, plan_follow, what it invented and what its check found. Notes the earlier writing left stay the author's until he closes them: meaning (a sentence the check of meaning fixed or could not check), repeat (a sentence that repeats the book), machine (a place the working judge quoted), brief (an item of the brief of the helper by its section).

number.description: Its short number, never repeated in the draft.

kind.description: specs/2026-11-06-writing-agent.md WA5.6, WA6, WA7.5: of the writing agent, `proofread` — a correction of the proofreading (specs/2026-11-07-writing-proofread.md, PR3): quote is what stands, replacement what goes in its place, category one of опечатка, орфография, пунктуация, грамматика, имена, оборот; `new` — what a scene invented, not canon until the chapter is in the book; `seam` — a seam of a piece taken from a version; `style`, `canon`, `craft`, `plan_follow` — what its check found. `replaced`: what the helper replaced on the author's direct request (specs/2026-11-04-writing-plain-path.md P5.6): `quote` is what stands there now, absent when the place was taken away, `replacement` what stood there, and applying it brings that back.

target.description: The working text, or none (a brief of the helper before specs/2026-11-06-writing-agent.md S8).

quote.description: Its place: the text as it stood when the note was written. The place of a variant is a whole scene (specs/2026-11-04-writing-plain-path.md P5.5).

replacement.description: What «Применить» puts in place of the quote; of an applied fix, what it was.

variantGroup.description: The variants of one place: «Взять этот вариант» at one dismisses the others.

blocks.description: specs/2026-11-06-writing-agent.md WA3.5: of a question card, what it holds — «план» or «сцена N».

known.description: Of a question card: what is known, with places and quotes.

effects.description: Of a question card: what each option means for the scene, in the order of the options.

recommend.description: Of a question card: the option the helper recommends.

fallback.description: Of a question card: the option the writing takes when the author skips the question.

level.description: specs/2026-11-06-writing-agent.md WA6.4: of a finding of the writing agent, how much it weighs.

category.description: Of a finding of the check of style: its category.

label.description: specs/2026-11-11-ux9-writing-b.md WB2.1: of a finding of style, its category in the author's words by the one table of the check (sagadraft.StyleLabel); absent for any other note.

bookQuote.description: Of a finding of the canon: the quote of the book it disagrees with.

scene.description: The scene of the plan the note is about.

turnId.description: The native turn of the helper that wrote the note, as providerTurnId of the timeline: the feed shows the note under the answer of that turn.

ReplaceChapterFromDraftRequest.description: specs/2026-11-05-voice-full-access.md A8.7: the revision of the draft the author saw and the title of the chapter he confirmed.

format.description: What it was read from; text is a pasted text.

books.description: The reading of each book with chapters, in the order of the saga.

waiting.description: What the reading waits for (specs/2026-11-12-desk-window.md WN3.1; specs/2026-11-13-desk-gateway.md GW4.3): helper — the helper of the build is not connected; consent — the helper is connected and the author has not allowed it to read the books of the saga yet, while the chat takes questions. Either way nobody reads the books, and the counts are of what was read before; remainingSeconds is null and letterPromised false. at.description: When the preparation ended; the page tells of one readiness once by it.

books.description: Books with chapters in the published text.

bytesTransferred.description: Bytes accepted from the uploaded file by the import job.

bytesTotal.description: Exact uploaded file size in bytes.

parsedChapters.description: Chapters parsed from the uploaded file. Omitted until parsing has completed.

indexedChapters.description: Chapters whose exact current text-index state is committed.

AuthorMaterialsImportJobSubject.description: The Job of an import of the author's materials; the text of the file stays in the import.

error.description: Failure of a failed job; null otherwise. A research_chat_turn that the model did not complete names the model failure class in code: model.usage_limit_exceeded (the model usage limit is exhausted), model.server_overloaded (the model is overloaded or temporarily unavailable, including its rate limit), model.http_connection_failed (the connection to the model failed or broke), model.context_window_exceeded (the chat no longer fits the model context), model.turn_interrupted (the turn was interrupted), model.session_ended (the session of the author that started the turn ended before it began: signing out everywhere, a change of the password, a block; in the desktop app, a restart — specs/2026-11-15-desk-interrupted-turn.md IT1.3), model.turn_failed (any other or unclassified model failure). A turn of the desktop app with the helper «Аккаунт CanonKeeper» (specs/2026-11-13-desk-account-ai.md AI2.3, AI2.5) names the refusal of the site of the account its last request got: model.daily_fence (the tokens of the day of the work of the app are over until the Moscow midnight), model.account_unlinked (the link with the account broke), model.permit_ended (the permit of the turn ended), model.site_unavailable (the site has no models now), model.app_unfit (the site does not take this version of the app), model.thread_too_large (the chat is too large for the site), model.site_unreachable (no connection with the site after the repeats); a turn whose permit went by unused while it waited ends with the refusal of the tier of the next one: quota.chat_turns_daily, quota.active_turns. A turn of the desktop app whose request was not sent ends with journal.unavailable (its record did not lie in the journal of what went out — specs/2026-11-14-desk-journal.md JR1.6).

queuePosition.description: getJob of a waiting chat turn: the number of waiting questions the fair queue takes before it (a writer's k-th waiting question counts with the writer's questions in work plus k - 1). Null for any other Job, state or operation.

questionReturned.description: getJob of a chat turn of the desktop app (specs/2026-11-13-desk-account-ai.md AI2.9): whether the unit of its question came back. yes — the site of the account returned it and nothing can take it back (only then a page may say «this question is not counted»); no — it stays counted; pending — the close did not reach the site or a request of the turn was dropped mid-stream, so a late answer may still take it back; none — no site counted it («Свой ИИ», no helper). Absent on the site and for any other Job.

cancel.description: Canonical API cancel URL when the job can be canceled.

timeline.description: Exact canonical timeline link; null when the current context cannot access the target.

chapterNumber.description: The number of the chapter as the reader shows it (specs/2026-11-15-reader-chapter-number.md RN1.2).

chapterDisplayTitle.description: The title without the number it writes, as the reader shows it; empty when the title is only its number (RN1.3).

unchangedChapters.description: update_book and update_preview: chapters whose title and text stay, spaces aside.

changedChapters.description: update_book and update_preview: chapters with other words or paragraphs.

addedChapters.description: update_book and update_preview: chapters the file adds.

removedChapters.description: update_book and update_preview: chapters the file no longer has; an update moves them to recently deleted.

punctuationChapters.description: update_book and update_preview: chapters with the same words and other signs, letter case or ё; they keep their card. Absent from results before 2026-11-05.

renamedChapters.description: update_book and update_preview: chapters under a new title, whatever their text. Absent from results before 2026-11-05.

ImportPreview.description: What update_book with the same file would change, on update_preview (specs/2026-10-27-update-book-from-file.md, UC6), and what it changed, on update_book since 2026-11-11 (specs/2026-11-11-ux7-trash.md TB4.1: «Что изменилось»). Only the creator of the Job reads the places of its chapters.

newCards.description: Chapters that would get a new card: with other words, and new ones.

threads.description: Whether the threads of the saga would be built anew after the update.

order.description: Place of the chapter in the book after the update; of a removed chapter, its place now.

previousTitle.description: The title before the update of a renamed chapter.

places.description: Up to two places of a chapter with other words or signs; only its creator reads them.

editedOnSite.description: Present and true on a chapter with other words or signs, or removed, whose text in the book now was written on the site — added from «Письмо» and not rewritten by a file since, or replaced by its edit: the file replaces or removes it (specs/2026-11-11-ux9-shelf-chat.md SC1.4).

ChapterDraftJobResult.description: The kind of work of a finished run; the text is in the draft.

mode.description: As the mode of its subject; write is history only.

AuthorMaterialsImportJobResult.description: How many candidates an import found; they are in the import.
